d: Dark espresso brown hair is styled into a high ponytail with long bangs framing a youthful, mature face and sharp, amethyst purple eyes. The slim build is dressed in a white top under a navy blue tactical jacket, paired with navy blue shorts, black thigh-high lace-up boots with armored knee plates, and a large navy blue tactical backpack. Accessories include black fingerless gloves, a black utility belt with a thigh pouch, and a chest rig holding red canisters. The figure is holding a black tactical assault rifle.
